items.description: The Alembic migration's downgrade() function executes without error and a subsequent upgrade() returns the schema to its upgraded state (marked @pytest.mark.migration, never targets alembic base)
Rows seeded with a per-run-unique key before the migration are present with their original column values after the migration runs on the real branch database
The boundary layer (app/routes/) contains no import of any SQLAlchemy or ORM symbol
The service layer (app/services/) contains no import of any SQLAlchemy or ORM symbol
The application reads DATABASE_URL exclusively from the process environment and raises a clear error when the variable is absent
Filing a stock level for a SKU at a location returns a durable record containing the SKU, location, quantity, and combined inventory_code
Navigating to /stock/file in <App> renders the stock filing form with data-testid='stock-file-form'
The filing form exposes a SKU input via data-testid='input-sku'
The filing form exposes a location input via data-testid='input-location'
The filing form exposes a quantity input via data-testid='input-quantity'
The filing form exposes an inventory_code input via data-testid='input-inventory-code'
Submitting the filing form with valid SKU/location/quantity/inventory_code calls the JSON API and shows a success indicator via data-testid='file-success'
Retrieving a previously filed stock record returns the exact quantity that was filed
Retrieving a previously filed stock record returns the exact combined inventory_code that was filed
Navigating to /stock/:sku/:location in <App> renders the stock record retrieval view with data-testid='stock-record-view'
The retrieval view displays the quantity exactly as filed via data-testid='record-quantity'
The retrieval view displays the inventory_code exactly as filed via data-testid='record-inventory-code'
Filing stock for a SKU-location pair that already has a record results in exactly one record existing for that pair
Filing stock for a SKU-location pair that already has a record surfaces no error to the caller
Filing stock for a SKU-location pair that already has a record updates the stored quantity to the newly filed value
Submitting the filing form for an already-existing SKU+location pair shows the success indicator and does not show an error element via data-testid='file-error'
After filing a duplicate SKU+location, navigating to /stock/:sku/:location shows the updated quantity from the second filing
Inserting a second row with the same (sku, location) pair raises a unique-constraint violation on the real branch database
A concurrent second upsert for the same (sku, location) key completes without a lost-update anomaly, confirming the read-then-write executes within a single transaction on the real branch database
An upsert that updates quantity on an existing stock_records row leaves created_at unchanged from its original value on the real branch database
Attempting to insert a row with a NULL value for any of quantity, sku, location, or inventory_code raises a not-null constraint violation on the real branch database
Attempting to insert a row with quantity = -1 raises a check-constraint violation on the real branch database
The service layer raises a rejection error before reaching the repository when the supplied quantity value is negative
The service layer raises a rejection error before reaching the repository when the requested deduction would drive the resulting stock level below zero
Every boundary endpoint returns a JSON response body; no server-rendered HTML is returned
A validation error response names the specific offending field in its message body
